permitted_evidence: family cutoff text and cutoff identifiers

decision_effects.ACCEPT: Freeze only the exact reviewed observation cutoffs, member registry, analysis-unit denominators, and allowed planning-display registry at the reviewed commit. This does not authorize member-value display, success rates, aggregation, inference, superiority, or publication evidence.
decision_effects.REVISE: Keep every freeze state open, preserve the reviewed candidate, make a versioned pre-observation revision, and repeat local validation and this review before any value display.
decision_effects.REJECT: Keep family comparison closed and preserve the rejected candidate and rationale.
decision_effects.DEFER: Keep the candidate unchanged and all freeze and display gates closed pending additional non-outcome evidence.

review_questions.subject: review target
review_questions.criterion: The review target is the exact locally validated D4 checkpoint and no later unreviewed candidate mutation is included.

review_questions.subject: outcome blindness
review_questions.criterion: The reviewer has not inspected projected values, raw values, family outcomes, aggregate results, or ranking information.

review_questions.subject: family population
review_questions.criterion: The exact qualified family order CF-01, CF-02, CF-05, and CF-06 is justified for the candidate review scope.

review_questions.subject: member registry
review_questions.criterion: The 13 declared member rows are complete, unique, and traceable to the D2/D3 contracts.

review_questions.subject: analysis units
review_questions.criterion: The 12 treatment-within-family analysis units are complete and do not treat member rows as independent denominator units.

review_questions.subject: CF-02 policy variants
review_questions.criterion: B1-01 and B1-05 remain separate traceability rows under the single CF-02:B1 analysis unit.

review_questions.subject: CF-01 cutoff
review_questions.criterion: OC-CF01-TERMINAL-ORACLE is terminal, non-adaptive, and does not permit a post-terminal message or additional recovery attempt.

review_questions.subject: CF-02 cutoff
review_questions.criterion: OC-CF02-NO-FAULT-COMPLETION is terminal, applies consistently to both B1 policy variants, and does not extend observation after a result.

review_questions.subject: CF-05 cutoff
review_questions.criterion: OC-CF05-STATUS-OPPORTUNITY stops after the declared telemetry opportunity and prohibits a replacement opportunity or recovery extension.

review_questions.subject: CF-06 cutoff
review_questions.criterion: OC-CF06-SINGLE-REPLAY permits exactly one declared replay evaluation after successful advancement and no additional replay, retry, or recovery action.

review_questions.subject: allowed fields
review_questions.criterion: Every family allowed-field list matches the authoritative D2 matrix in membership and order without widening.

review_questions.subject: missing units
review_questions.criterion: A missing declared analysis unit blocks the family display and never shrinks the denominator.

review_questions.subject: extra units
review_questions.criterion: An undeclared analysis unit is rejected and never expands the denominator.

review_questions.subject: display registry
review_questions.criterion: Only identity, membership, cutoff, allowed-field-name, and coverage-completeness planning displays are currently allowed; side-by-side member values remain separately gated.

review_questions.subject: revision control
review_questions.criterion: Any pre-display change requires a versioned candidate and repeated validation; any post-display change must be labeled post-observation and preserve the superseded plan.

review_questions.subject: claim boundary
review_questions.criterion: The review cannot authorize success rates, pooled aggregation, inference, superiority, causal interpretation, cryptographic claims, independent validation, or publication evidence.
